endpoints.purpose: Generate an ephemeral client secret (short-lived API key) to initialize a WebRTC or WebSocket connection from the client side. GA interface only.     request_format: application/json body with session config (type, model, audio.output.voice, modalities, instructions, turn_detection, tools, etc.)     python_request_param: json=     response_format: JSON with client_secret.value (ephemeral token string) and session metadata

WebRTC SDP exchange — browser sends its SDP offer; API returns SDP answer to establish WebRTC peer connection. Requires ephemeral token in Authorization header. Response includes Location header with call_id for sideband WebSocket control.     request_format: raw SDP text body, Content-Type application/sdp     python_request_param: data=     response_format: SDP text (answer); Location header = unique call URL

Main bidirectional WebSocket connection for Realtime sessions. Query param ?model= selects the model. All conversation turns, audio streaming, VAD, tool calling, and transcription happen over this connection via JSON events.     request_format: WebSocket upgrade; query params: model (required), call_id (optional for sideband sideband control)     python_request_param: N/A (WebSocket — use websocket-client or openai SDK)     response_format: Streaming JSON events (session.created, response.created, response.done, audio deltas, etc.)
